nearest_neighbours_do_not: Whisp does not output a continuous mismatch score or rank degree of implausibility — it emits three discrete risk buckets from static, curated commodity/forest maps, so a landscape/commodity absent from those input maps falls into 'more info needed' rather than being flagged by embedding-space similarity, and it cannot generalize beyond its curated map layers.
